label: D1 after a common a1->S1 trial (fixation step, early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1, the fixation step (never at GO or D2). It fires when the previous trial was a1 followed by a common transition to S1. After a2 or rare transitions it is almost silent (prev_common=0 holds 1.5% of the mass). On the window first trial the previous choice is outside the window, so the agent own upcoming choice (action==1 at D1, which it computes itself) stands in for it. The predicate uses no future random outcome. Activity falls off across the episode: it is near zero after trial 80, so ep_trial<80 is included. Magnitude: the largest activations come at D1 after an UNREWARDED a1->S1c trial (r0, up to the max), and the value grows over runs of rewarded a1->S1 trials (about 0.2 -> 0.6). Many D1 steps after rewarded a1->S1 trials stay silent, which limits precision (about 0.58 on dev). Recall is about 0.93 and mass recall about 0.96. It is closely tied to a1/S1: it rarely fires when S2 is good or after a2. The model value is mid-range (7.1-7.7) whenever it is active.
